//: Deployed with `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes`. Firestore indexes every field automatically, but only at COLLECTION scope and only one field at a time — so any query that filters on one field and sorts on another, or that runs across a collection GROUP, needs declaring here or it fails outright at call time rather than degrading.

indexes.//: adminListFeedback filtering by status. The dashboard opens on the 'new' filter, so without this the feedback inbox is empty on arrival — the one screen that has to work while testers are sending things in.

fieldOverrides.//: adminRecentActivity reads sessions across every account, which is a collection GROUP query — a scope the automatic index does not cover.
fieldOverrides.//1: The two COLLECTION entries are load-bearing and must not be dropped. A fieldOverride REPLACES the automatic single-field indexes for this field rather than adding to them, and the app's own library listing sorts users/{uid}/sessions by createdAt. Declaring only the collection-group index here would fix the dashboard and break every user's notes list.
